notes.title: Kuboom - V4.1 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/e8a20809f99a288991b847f61278dee809cdd8ed.png
Kuboom 4.1 has been released.
And with the release of this new update, we'd like to publish the patch notes for this massive content update.

Here are the highlights first.


 User Icons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/0f2c19e3b03828a0fd0113652765eee7fc08c948.png
As of this update, users can change their icons within the lobby and it'll appear on their friends list! It adds a bit of style and personalization to the UI.

 User Tags
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/1a3f9ae6a0a2cd2133d8e10f7341167790b6c9e1.png
In addition to having user icons, players will be able to choose a tag that will appear on the friends list!

 Region Selection
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/0a0ab47b27ca91d7a8b3c9b7d66fab4839d9cde8.png
Players are now able to choose the region for which they host/play games in! This will improve connectivity and will make the game much more responsive.

 Defusal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/8dc33a59c3a2b2cf15a2107bc89f61ca45e05b38.png
That's right. Defusal mode makes its return with 3 new maps created specifically for the game-mode! Players will have to protect or defuse a bomb before it explodes! 

Keep in mind, respawning is disabled in this mode!

Thats not all of course, We also added smaller additions. Such as the option to change the FOV or the crosshair with a sleuth of customization options to choose from.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/5ea3362776443c404e686946a3137d930fca759c.png

Changelog

 Added "Bomb" mode with 3 new additional maps.
 New map "Asia" is available for play in the Duel mode.
 Added Avatars and Titles
 New daily contracts system. Complete with achievements
 Two new skin collections.
 New black market | Secret skins will be available through here.
 Ability to adjust the scope and FOV
 Massive improvements to hit-registration and netcode
 Improvements to AI (Will navigate appropriately)
 Improvements to movement
 New weapon sounds


We're dedicated to giving continued support for Kuboom, and we thank our players for continuing to enjoy these updates!

We have much more in store, so stay tuned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/c0b2548f084fbf7b6cc1cc9aa48c1c19a9e516b7.png

notes.title: Kuboom - Version 3.0 Release
notes.notes:
Kuboom 3.0 Is here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/a77b36c77604b455e7810a4df7944746c450b40c.png

Kuboom 3.0 has finally been released and is the biggest update the game has received so far and the changelog reflects that, which is what we'll be getting into now.


Survival Mode

The biggest addition this update has is the brand new mode. Survival!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/d9ba134602bb1bfd6239a41fda0e23f2dd2ac8df.jpg

In this mode you have to survive against a horde of zombies. Bonuses will spawn around the map
which will help you survive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/45ccfc77c5ccc2e2e4b4a189d077437982165817.jpg

If your teammates get killed, you can revive them! But be careful as they will be low on health and ammunition. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/b656e7cd4e8a51b345fc076b346582dd72eed1c0.jpg

Bots

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/75f9cd19686a42f19f89b51efe20c782e1f1898f.jpg

Bots are automatically added to matches to fill player slots until more players join. You will
still gain XP, cash and rewards from Bot matches. Even if the entire game is a bot match.

Clan Wars and Clan System Overhaul

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/67cdb90d00c313f78ce82b3323ee770dd32b127b.png

Clan wars are finally back! A long-awaited feature has returned in a new form!

The entire clan system has been remade from the ground up!

New features include a win/loss ratio..

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/acd35613b194b5d1b8e22d2d8dc519f1997a2db2.png

Clan chat..

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/fcf33370e1aa881f5a24cc61a32058e2c701756b.png

And more. Clan wars occur every few hours and when it starts your clan will go against another clan. The clan with the most points will win the war! Your clan will then be rewarded with Rating Points and Clan points. The higher the points, the higher your clan will be on the leaderboard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/971872bad068015b744d7b55cf23667705d6a86a.png

New Challenges
There has been a load of new challenges and rewards added, and even daily jobs!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/b79031ef1cf79356c0663bb7c7650f0ee9f51784.png

You even get rewards for leveling up and reaching a new rank!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/1457195decf8b534c5e534cc61661969768db10a.png

The higher your rank is, the higher you'll be on the leaderboard! and players that are in the top 10 will receieve 100 keys every leaderboard reset.

New Shaders
The game has also gotten a few graphical improvements. New shadows and shaders have been added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/0bc8bfcc056187c477c2147f9851cd6c5205d26c.jpg

New Weapon attachments!

A few new weapon attachments have been added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/77f3917894c62463012a309496399bdaff411b34.png
A Kuboom Inc. Kill counter has been added as a legendary item!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/1bfa3a41154f489d56b332521198cff3d6a927bf.png

New scopes have also been made available and can be found in cases or purchased!

New Skins!
1 New skin and 2 new classes are able to be unlocked via Parts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/4b9b3eb63464efb21185021ae8aa05baf09a1f48.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/adb7780cafff41ea51d866f2d45ac7a911289366.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/89d4f3c3cb9387d2a6b4953c41ad39efe55d9906.png

Parts can be unlocked from opening legendary cases.

New Items!

And a few new items has been added to the shop!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/b55ba6bd0eb6e408c0ed5561c0f7765ae84e6905.png

New maps!

There are lots of new maps that have been added in this update, I'll show just a few maps but there are tons more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/81f669053d6da69f3dac84b6dda707184c720c58.jpg
Aztec - TDM/DM

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/248ccc34359c027b5e4f43f11f76dd191c057e4f.jpg
Streets - Survival

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/e95e6c36d41d02efb8d31e45cc07ec296c8259ac.jpg
Neon - DM/TDM

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/5b31a197825bb38b70a6925054c921a8d62184b9.jpg
Shopping Centre - Gun Game

Theres so much more!
Thats not all this update has to offer! Theres alot more features that I didn't get around to covering. Some minor but the major ones are all listed.

We hope you enjoy this update! Stay tuned for more updates later on in the year.

Join our discord! - https://discord.gg/EZeZ8xu

notes.title: Kuboom - GLOBAL UPDATE 2.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/67b3487d52bfa795aee5fb3615b2c4eef7926c64.jpg

Hello Everyone!

The most anticipated update is here.. There are hundreds of changes but we're showing off the most important ones right here in this announcement!

New Interface
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/490515853f4c8ca7e58f9c369b1a33fadcb4813b.png

We've redesigned the games UI and menu to make it easier to implement new features and options later down the line! It's much more clean than the older menu.

Not only has the menu changed visually, there is also a new song to go with it! 

Launch the game and take a listen after you're done reading this announcement!

New Case System

Cases will no longer drop duplicate items! This means any skin/item you have in a case will not be selected.

New Box System

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/d35f61bd02996bd912afc12a514696dbc1e67791.png

Another case equivalent has been introduced. Boxes are similar to cases but instead of getting a single item upon selection, you will now get 3 items of the same rarity! (more on rarities later) Boxes can be purchased with our new currency, Keys.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/9c42715dee0a31b6869f302210149f08e095b30f.png

There are are 2 ways of earning keys.

You can do the daily tasks to earn keys and you will also have a chance to earn keys after the end of a match via round end cards. At the end of a match, you'll be given a choice of 3 cards (4 If you have VIP) and one of those cards could have a chance of giving a key!

Of course, there are no duplicates here either!

Rarity System

Items are now ranked based off of their rarity. Items with a higher rarity will have a lesser chance of being collected/Higher price. Items with a lower rarity will have a higher chance of being collected/Lower Price.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/69333c036048d4d3d2e69f20cf91a0cc8c321dae.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/e217a7d3e623ab62756b925a9b94046f637a4b6f.png

Skins, Weapons, Items and Modules can all have a different rarity and some items with a legendary to secret rarity can completely transform the item into something else!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/bab9b90a9f7324587a8bf01e8ae55f3fab8573a9.png

Rarity Categories are


 Normal - Gray
 Rare - Blue
 Legendary - Gold
 Secret - Red


Secrets are normally earned through tasks or events.

New Maps and New Mode

We've added 4 new maps and a brand new game mode in this update!

Introducing: Gun Game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/80ef2ed9344e64ec2a1f0deeb9bf558649205a05.png

Gun Game is a free-for-all game but with a twist, every 2 kills you are granted a new weapon and the first one to get a knife and kill a player wins the game!

Its way easier said than done. But a unique game-mode nonetheless!

Along with Gun Game there are a few new maps for it as well!

Village
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/022ea02c52c10a2c89aad1efafa6dc5886123baf.jpg

Interchange
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/31c244d2a67ab3ca4aab572d9e22f6de8b6082d7.jpg

Canyon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/5ee3c5b2a2714a5e41733cd26641611794297c54.jpg

And while we have maps for Gun Game we also have a new map for team deathmatch named "Microdistrict"

Microdistrict
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/6734962c216a9aa0e7d3d01e0fdcbb95dd24b917.jpg

Additional Improvements
And with that we've reached the end of the major updates, so here are the not-so-major updates.

- Third equipment slot is now available to all players instead of just VIP players.

- Improved Netcode

- New languages: Spanish and Turkish!

- Improved anti-cheat and optimized the game!

- De-buffed the Clown characters.

- Fixed many bugs!

Closing

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/76fab016fd6bc01979ad25f3238260faa31257e8.jpg

Thank you for your continued support! We hope you enjoy this update! 

As for what is planned in the future, We're looking at changing the core fundamentals of the game; Such as movement and feel. We're also going to bring back clan wars and overhaul it once again, and we're also working on something very secret. 



Stay Tuned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/a77b36c77604b455e7810a4df7944746c450b40c.png
